title: IRD Guide: Excise Tax
text:
Excise Tax
Governance
Excise Tax (Amendment) Act, 2006, Act 3 of 2006
Excise Tax (Amendment) Order 2008, SRO 36 of 2008
Excise Tax (Amendment) Order, 2006, SRO 14 of 2006
Excise Tax Act, 2005, Act 8 of 2005
Excise Tax Order, 2006, SRO 5 of 2006
Payee
Manufacturers and importers of taxable goods
Due Date
For both importers and local manufacturers deadline for payment is the 20th day of each calendar month
Tax Rate
Stoute/Beer: $1.2/Litre
Wine: $1.2/Litre
Shandy: $0.28/Litre
Brandy/Ginger/Voldka: $8.50/Litre
Whiskey: $12.60/Litre
Rum: $2.60/Litre
Cigarette: $22/kg
Petrol (jet fuel,kerosene): $1.14/gallon
Petrol (diesel): $2.38/gallon
Petrol (Gas): $3.00/gallon
Vehicles: 15% & 28%
Liquor & Cordial: $2.6/Litre
Taxed Items
Alcohol, cigarettes, vehicles and petrol
Filing
Returns are filed monthly
View all forms on our Forms page.
